measures.name: Dynamic_Metric_Description
measures.description: Plain-language definition of whichever evaluation metric is currently selected in Evaluation Metric Parameter
measures.dax:
VAR SelectedMetricText = SELECTEDVALUE('Evaluation Metric Parameter'[Parameter Fields])
VAR DescriptionText = 
    SWITCH(
        TRUE(),
        CONTAINSSTRING(SelectedMetricText, "Precision"), "Out of the top 5 products recommended, what percentage were actual reorders.",
        CONTAINSSTRING(SelectedMetricText, "Recall"), "Out of the total reorders, what percentage were captured in the top 5 recommendations.",
        CONTAINSSTRING(SelectedMetricText, "F1"), "The harmonic mean of Precision and Recall, identifying if one metric is inflated at the expense of the other.",
        CONTAINSSTRING(SelectedMetricText, "NDCG"), "Rewards models that place true reorders higher in the top 5 list (Order Matters).",
        "Select a metric from the slicer to see its analytical definition."
    )
RETURN
    DescriptionText & ""

measures.name: Feature_Y_Axis_Position
measures.description: Vertical position for a beeswarm plot point, offset slightly within its feature's row to avoid perfect overlap
measures.dax:
-- Step 1: Get the baseline rank of the feature (e.g., 1 through 15)
VAR BaseRank = SELECTEDVALUE('beeswarm_plot_data'[feature_importance_rank])

-- Step 2: Extract the unique plot ID integer for this specific dot
VAR RowID = SELECTEDVALUE('beeswarm_plot_data'[unique_plot_id])

-- Step 3: Add an incredibly tiny fraction to make the coordinate 100% unique to Power BI
VAR Jitter = DIVIDE(RowID, 100000000) 

RETURN
    BaseRank + Jitter

measures.name: SHAP_Color_Scale
measures.description: This point's feature value, normalized 0–1 within that feature's own range, used to color the beeswarm plot
measures.dax:
-- Step 1: Capture the current row's feature name and individual feature value
VAR CurrentFeature = SELECTEDVALUE('beeswarm_plot_data'[feature_name])
VAR IndividualValue = AVERAGE('beeswarm_plot_data'[feature_value])

-- Step 2: Compute the min and max for ONLY this specific feature across the dataset
VAR FeatureMin = 
    CALCULATE(
        MIN('beeswarm_plot_data'[feature_value]), 
        REMOVEFILTERS('beeswarm_plot_data'), 
        'beeswarm_plot_data'[feature_name] = CurrentFeature,
        'beeswarm_plot_data'[feature_value] < 999 -- Defensive drop for outliers/flags
    )

VAR FeatureMax = 
    CALCULATE(
        MAX('beeswarm_plot_data'[feature_value]), 
        REMOVEFILTERS('beeswarm_plot_data'), 
        'beeswarm_plot_data'[feature_name] = CurrentFeature,
        'beeswarm_plot_data'[feature_value] < 999 -- Defensive drop for outliers/flags
    )

-- Step 3: Run a 0-to-1 Min-Max calculation scaled strictly to this feature's domain
VAR NormalizedValue = 
    DIVIDE(
        IndividualValue - FeatureMin, 
        FeatureMax - FeatureMin, 
        0
    )
RETURN
    NormalizedValue

measures.name: Champion_Model
measures.description: Name of the model with the highest validation Recall at 5 — treated as champion throughout the dashboard
measures.dax:
VAR ModelSummary = 
    ADDCOLUMNS(
        VALUES(Validation_Evaluation_Metrics[Model]),
        "@ValRecall", 
        CALCULATE(
            MAX(Validation_Evaluation_Metrics[Recall_at_5])
        )
    )
VAR MaxRecallValue = 
    MAXX(ModelSummary, [@ValRecall])
VAR BestModelName = 
    MAXX(
        FILTER(ModelSummary, [@ValRecall] = MaxRecallValue),
        Validation_Evaluation_Metrics[Model]
    )
RETURN 
    BestModelName

measures.name: Conversion_Profit_Lift
measures.description: Additional annual profit from extra orders driven by the model's Recall, via the conversion-lift assumption
measures.dax:
VAR Annual_Orders = [SEC_2025_Annual_Orders]
VAR Profit_Margin = [SEC_2025_Profit_Margin]
VAR Base_AOV = [Base_AOV]

VAR Recall = IF(SELECTEDVALUE(evaluation_metrics[Model]) = "No Widget", 0, [Recall])
VAR RecallUnits = Recall / 0.10

VAR Extra_Orders = Annual_Orders * (RecallUnits * [Conversion Lift per 10% Recall Value])

RETURN
Extra_Orders * Base_AOV * Profit_Margin

measures.name: Base_AOV
measures.description: Baseline average order value: total revenue divided by annual orders
measures.dax: DIVIDE([SEC_2025_Total_Revenue], [SEC_2025_Annual_Orders], 0)

measures.name: Conversion_Rate
measures.description: Passthrough of the current conversion-rate assumption, for use in visit/traffic calculations
measures.dax: 'Conversion Rate'[Conversion Rate Value]

measures.name: Annual_Visits
measures.description: Estimated annual site visits, derived from annual orders and the conversion-rate assumption
measures.dax: DIVIDE([SEC_2025_Annual_Orders], [Conversion_Rate], 0)

measures.name: Annual_User_Orders
measures.description: Average number of orders per active customer per year
measures.dax: DIVIDE([SEC_2025_Annual_Orders], [SEC_2025_Active_Customers], 0)

measures.name: Churn_Profit_Lift
measures.description: Additional annual profit from customers retained (reduced churn) due to the model's Recall, via the churn-reduction assumption
measures.dax:
VAR Active_Users = [SEC_2025_Active_Customers]
VAR Annual_User_Orders = [Annual_User_Orders]
VAR Base_AOV = [Base_AOV]
VAR Profit_Margin = [SEC_2025_Profit_Margin]

VAR Recall = IF(SELECTEDVALUE(evaluation_metrics[Model]) = "No Widget", 0, [Recall])
VAR RecallUnits = Recall / 0.10

VAR New_Churn_Rate = MAX(0.01, [Churn Rate Value] - (RecallUnits * [Churn Reduction per 10% Recall Value]))
VAR Extra_Customers_Retained = Active_Users * ([Churn Rate Value] - New_Churn_Rate)

RETURN
Extra_Customers_Retained * Annual_User_Orders * Base_AOV * Profit_Margin

measures.name: Annual_Profit_Lift

measures.name: AOV_Profit_Lift
measures.description: Additional annual profit from a higher average order value, driven by the model's Recall via the AOV-lift assumption
measures.dax:
VAR Annual_Orders = [SEC_2025_Annual_Orders]
VAR Active_Users = [SEC_2025_Active_Customers]
VAR Annual_User_Orders = [Annual_User_Orders]
VAR Base_AOV = [Base_AOV]
VAR Profit_Margin = [SEC_2025_Profit_Margin]

VAR Recall = IF(SELECTEDVALUE(evaluation_metrics[Model]) = "No Widget", 0, [Recall])
VAR RecallUnits = Recall / 0.10

-- 1. Calculate New AOV
VAR New_AOV = Base_AOV + (RecallUnits * [AOV Lift per 10% Recall Value])

-- 2. Extra Order AOV Lift (From Conversion)
VAR Extra_Orders = Annual_Orders * (RecallUnits * [Conversion Lift per 10% Recall Value])
VAR Extra_Order_AOV_Lift = (Extra_Orders * New_AOV * Profit_Margin) - [Conversion_Profit_Lift]

-- 3. Extra Customer AOV Lift (From Retention)
VAR New_Churn_Rate = MAX(0.01, [Churn Rate Value] - (RecallUnits * [Churn Reduction per 10% Recall Value]))
VAR Extra_Customers_Retained = Active_Users * ([Churn Rate Value] - New_Churn_Rate)
VAR Extra_Customer_AOV_Lift = (Extra_Customers_Retained * Annual_User_Orders * New_AOV * Profit_Margin) - [Churn_Profit_Lift]

-- 4. Baseline Order AOV Lift (From existing transaction stream)
VAR Baseline_Order_AOV_Lift = (Annual_Orders * New_AOV * Profit_Margin) - [Baseline_Profit]

RETURN
Extra_Order_AOV_Lift + Extra_Customer_AOV_Lift + Baseline_Order_AOV_Lift

measures.name: Pct_Diff_Churn_Profit_Lift
measures.description: Percentage improvement in churn-driven profit lift of the champion model over the heuristic baseline
measures.dax: DIVIDE([Champion Churn Profit Lift] - [Heuristic Churn Profit Lift], [Heuristic Churn Profit Lift], 0)

measures.name: Pct_Diff_Conversion_Profit_Lift
measures.description: Percentage improvement in conversion-driven profit lift of the champion model over the heuristic baseline
measures.dax: DIVIDE([Champion Conversion Profit Lift] - [Heuristic Conversion Profit Lift], [Heuristic Conversion Profit Lift], 0)

measures.name: Conversion_Stage1_Baseline_Orders
measures.description: Waterfall stage value: baseline annual order count before any model impact
measures.dax: [SEC_2025_Annual_Orders]

measures.name: Conversion_Stage2_Extra_Orders
measures.description: Waterfall stage value: additional orders driven by the model's Recall via the conversion-lift assumption
measures.dax:
VAR Annual_Orders = [SEC_2025_Annual_Orders]
VAR Recall = IF(SELECTEDVALUE(evaluation_metrics[Model]) = "No Widget", 0, [Recall])
VAR RecallUnits = Recall / 0.10
VAR Extra_Orders = Annual_Orders * (RecallUnits * [Conversion Lift per 10% Recall Value])

RETURN
Extra_Orders

measures.name: Conversion_Stage3_Profit_Lift
measures.description: Waterfall stage value: profit lift from additional orders
measures.dax: [Conversion_Profit_Lift]

measures.name: Master_Waterfall_Values
measures.description: Routes each waterfall stage (Baseline Profit, Conversion/Churn/AOV Profit Lift) to its value, based on the currently selected stage
measures.dax:
SWITCH(
    SELECTEDVALUE(Waterfall_Dimensions[Stage Name]),
    "Baseline Profit", CALCULATE([Baseline_Profit], REMOVEFILTERS(Waterfall_Dimensions)),
    "Conversion Profit Lift", CALCULATE([Conversion_Profit_Lift], REMOVEFILTERS(Waterfall_Dimensions)),
    "Churn Profit Lift", CALCULATE([Churn_Profit_Lift], REMOVEFILTERS(Waterfall_Dimensions)),
    "AOV Profit Lift", CALCULATE([AOV_Profit_Lift], REMOVEFILTERS(Waterfall_Dimensions)),
    BLANK()
)

measures.name: Conversion_Dyanmic_Tool_Tip
measures.description: Tooltip text summarizing the baseline conversion rate, the model's lift, and the resulting new conversion rate
measures.dax:
VAR Recall = IF(SELECTEDVALUE(evaluation_metrics[Model]) = "No Widget", 0, [Recall])
VAR RecallUnits = Recall / 0.10
VAR Lift_Amount = RecallUnits * [Conversion Lift per 10% Recall Value]
VAR New_Conv = [Conversion Rate Value] + Lift_Amount

RETURN
"Baseline Conversion Rate: " & FORMAT([Conversion Rate Value], "0.00%") & 
" | Model Lift: +" & FORMAT(Lift_Amount, "0.00%") & 
" | New Conversion Rate: " & FORMAT(New_Conv, "0.00%")

measures.name: Yaxis_min
measures.description: Lower bound for the waterfall chart's Y-axis, set just below baseline profit
measures.dax: [Baseline_Profit] - 100000000

measures.name: Yaxis_max
measures.description: Upper bound for the waterfall chart's Y-axis, set just above total annual profit
measures.dax: [Annual_Profit] *1.017

AOV Lift per 10% Recall[AOV Lift per 10% Recall]
